01 / ABOUT

WHO ARE WE?

Four perspectives, one shared ambition: turn curiosity into action.

NextGen Founder is a team of four engineering students from MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune, brought together by a shared interest in entrepreneurship, creativity, research and innovation. We combine different strengths and perspectives to transform ideas into meaningful solutions.
